panelists.lens: Would a smart stranger get this in six seconds?
attributes: Reads the record, not the author's mind

panelists.lens: What are we pretending is true?
attributes: Attacks the strongest point, never the weakest

panelists.lens: Are we measuring the right thing?
attributes: Separates 'did a person understand it' from 'will it hold up over time'
Names it every time one meter answers for the other

panelists.lens: What does the lazy path produce?
attributes: Traces what happens when everyone does the easiest thing the words allow
Blames the shape, not the people, when the easy path yields the wrong outcome

panelists.lens: Does a person actually want this?
attributes: Speaks for effort, interruption, and dignity
Asks for breaks; points out where work runs past its reader
A voice, not a veto — the room decides together
